records.subject: HfS2 monolayer
records.object: Lattice thermal conductivity 2.19 W m−1 K−1
records.quote: In this work, k(L) in hafnium (Hf) dichalcogenide monolayers has been investigated based on ab initio DFT coupled to linearized Boltzmann transport equation together with single-mode relaxation-time approximation.
context_quotes: Ultra-low k(L) found in HfS2 (2.19 W m(-1) K-1), HfSe2 (1.23 W m(-1) K-1) and HfSSe (1.78 W m(-1) K-1) monolayers at 300 K, is comparable to that of the state-of-art bulk thermoelectric materials, such as, Bi2Te3 (1.6 W m(-1) K-1), PbTe (2.2 W m(-1) K-1) and SnSe (2.6 W m(-1) K-1).
modality_evidence: In this work, k(L) in hafnium (Hf) dichalcogenide monolayers has been investigated based on ab initio DFT coupled to linearized Boltzmann transport equation together with single-mode relaxation-time approximation.
